llm_reason: Ceiling assessment: existing-system idealized architecture caps at 487.3 Wh/kg (< 500.94) -> material escalation. ED levers: (1) LNMO 4.7V cathode raises cell voltage ~+13% vs NMC811 (ED ~scales with V); (2) OKane2022 graphite+SiOx negative (next round). Plating/heat levers: high-transport electrolyte (sigma 1.8 S/m, t+ 0.4, D 2e-10) + small particles + thin negative. Molecular additives (FEC/VC/PES/DTD) screened in funnel for SEI/plating suppression; additives affect aging/SEI not direct ED. Params listed before run.
